translation: ⟨How much better⟩ to get Jojmá than gold! and ⟨to⟩ get Biná ⟨is⟩ rather to be chosen than silver!

notes.subject: Jojmá
notes.rationale: Hebrew חכמה (wisdom) is rendered as Jojmá, preserving the Hebrew lemma from the Tanaj

notes.subject: מה
notes.rationale: Hebrew interrogative מה rendered as English idiom 'How much better' to capture comparative sense

notes.subject: טוב
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'good' used idiomatically in comparative construction 'better than gold'

notes.subject: to
notes.rationale: English infinitive requires 'to', not present in Hebrew finite verb form

notes.subject: Biná
notes.rationale: Hebrew בינה (understanding) is rendered as Biná, preserving the Hebrew lemma from the Tanaj

notes.subject: is
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks copula; 'is' added for English grammar
